evidence_proposition: On a two-period chain whose y intercept shifts between periods with x unchanged, the kernel two-sample (MMD on residuals) detection flags y at significance 0.05.
limitations: A qualitative detection outcome on one seeded two-period dataset: no MMD value, permutation p-value, power or false-positive rate is derived or compared with an independent calculation. By-construction truth of which mechanism changed is not a numeric closed form. No calibration.

oracle.origin: Current review of retained local contract inputs and their exact executing consumer; this record asserts no external generator or independent numerical origin.
